english.title: Portable battery producer failed to comply with requirements for financing waste collection
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a producer of portable batteries in respect of a compliance period, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPLIANCE PERIOD..), during which you placed such batteries on the market in the United Kingdom, failed to finance the net costs arising from the collection, treatment and recycling of your share of all waste portable batteries collected in the United Kingdom
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 7, 8, 89(1)(a)(i) and 90(2) of the Waste Batteries and Accumulators Regulations 2009.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a producer of portable batteries
who placed portable batteries on the market in the UK
failed to finance the net costs arising from
collection, treatment and recycling
of its share of portable waste batteries collected in the UK

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Regulation 7(3) states a small producer is not under a duty to finance the net costs arising from the collection, treatment or recycling of its share of waste portable batteries.
